no_condition.why: No trigger bar. The trigger is an OWNERSHIP/REGIME label - 'chain-drift-family content owns a weekend WITH a live chain', then plain-vs-covering regime - and neither chain ownership, chain liveness nor 'first covering print in COT' is a served numeric quantity (no chain block exists in the vocabulary; cot.managed_money_net_chg_wow could show net covering but the play states no bar on it and 'FIRST covering print' is a sequencing rule, not a level). The numbers the play carries - the [600..1600] class, the ~2200 doubled rung, the <=690 Sunday prior - are OUTPUT magnitude bands on the emitted day-move, not gates on whether it fires. The brain's own health field says the same: the ownership precondition is what changes state and the rungs mostly do not.

All three trigger limbs are unserved or carry no bar. (1) 'chain stretched near its extreme' is cum-from-anchor vs block range - cum_from_anchor is not in the served vocabulary at all, and E declares it PRICE-MASKED and UNEVALUATED at the blind. (2) 'the chain-side driver fully PRICED with its realization window crossing the weekend closure' is a pricing-time/realization-timing read with no threshold. (3) 'the evening run delivering the shot's first same-sign trim' is a SIGN plus a SEQUENCING condition ('first'), and the sign it must take is relative to the chain side, which is unserved; weather_forecast.forecast_run_delta is served and is the D-1 evening run delta, but the play states no bar on it. The -600..-1200 basing-counter numbers are the output band. Day-of-week ('a Friday') is also not a served numeric quantity.

THE BAR IS REAL AND ITS QUANTITY IS NOT SERVED. The play's bar is |imb10| >= ~0.05 on a Monday 06:00 ET L1-10 RESTING-DEPTH imbalance snapshot. No imb10 / imb_R / depth-imbalance path exists in the vocabulary. The three served l1_book fields are tape_conditions.l1_book.quote_bid_share, .quote_updates and .spread_ticks_med - quote_bid_share is a bid-side share of QUOTE UPDATE COUNTS at L1 only, which is a different quantity (wrong depth, wrong object, wrong timestamp), and naming it would be exactly the hole-#8/#9 error. The play's own falsifier says what is missing: 'serve imb10 in decision_state at the Monday 06:00 ET snapshot'. Separately, firehose_present.l1_book is FALSE on every modern Monday, so even the L1 fields are absent at the decision point.

The play emits a CATEGORICAL exit-type label (crest_trim_fadeable / positioning_spent_fade / fundamental_carry_continue / momentum_carry), not a gated call, and its trigger - 'any Friday close going into a weekend seam' - is unconditional. Its discriminating tell, last-hour price-dir vs last-hour signed-flow, is not served: no last_hour_dir or last_hour_signed_flow path exists in the vocabulary, the record says it is MBO-measured only for G15, and the exit_states file that carries it is declared refine-only ('a blind run must never read this file'). The calendar inputs ARE served (flow_calendar.days_to_opex, .days_to_futures_expiry, .gsci_roll_day_n, .bcom_roll_day_n) but the play states them as STATES with no number - 'index-roll LAST day', 'an index roll whose WINDOW is still open Monday' - and inventing a roll-day threshold to fill the slot would be manufacturing a bar the play does not have.

The discriminator is the LOCATION of the driver's peak in the forward ladder - 'peak still AHEAD of Monday' vs 'peak lands Sat/Sun/Mon' - which is an argmax/ordering over horizons, not a level crossing a threshold. There is no bar to write. The quantity is also not served as a scalar: it lives in weather_forecast.horizons, a LIST of per-horizon rows, and the only served weather_forecast scalars are the D0 levels (forecast_gw_hdd / forecast_gw_cdd) and the run-over-run REVISION deltas (forecast_run_delta / forecast_run_delta_cdd). forecast_run_delta_cdd is the nearest-looking name and measures something else entirely - this run versus the previous MODEL RUN, not this horizon versus the next HORIZON - so it must not be used for the h0-vs-h1 step the specialists actually ran ('h1 CDD 15.933 > h0 14.815'). The falsifier's proposed burn-residual limb (grid_stack est_gas_burn net of wind/solar) is a proposed test, not the play's bar.

An OR-trigger whose both limbs sit on unserved quantities. Limb (a) 'closing at an EXTREME cum-from-anchor' - cum_from_anchor is absent from the vocabulary and is price content the blind masks (E declared it UNEVALUATED twice, at G22 0626 and G23 0710). Limb (b) 'a MATURE chain (age >= 4)' is a genuine numeric bar but chain age is served nowhere: there is no chain block in the vocabulary, and the only age-like paths are cot.age_days, grid_stack.age_days, steo_vintage.age_days and vol_regime.n0_prev_age_days, all of which are data-staleness clocks for a feed, not the age of a directional chain.

Three explicit bars, all on quantities that are not served. (1) close_off_extreme >= ~0.95 (coff, or <=0.05 on the low side) - no close_off_extreme / close_off_low_frac path exists in the vocabulary; it lives only in the refine-only exit_states files, which is why the blind declares the limb 'PRICE-based and masked; unevaluable'. (2) the prior day's own run >= ~$1200 - day_move_usd is not served either. The tempting near-match is vol_regime.n0_prev_net, and I MEASURED it before rejecting it: vol_regime carries masked_one_shot=true and is FROZEN at the block-anchor vintage, so n0_prev_net is a per-block CONSTANT on every staged day (g20 -1000, g21 -1350, g22 -80, g23 +270) reporting the anchor Friday rather than day N-1, and its own note says the n0 family is computed on a degraded continuous store carrying a fifth to a quarter of the scored leg's tape. It is neither the right session nor the right tape. (3) chain age >= 2 (the fresh-turn VOID clause) - chain age is served nowhere.
